summary: Frontend-only regression test for the AI Detect close (X) bug. BUG NOT FIXED. Verified via mobile viewport (390x844) on the public preview URL: after registering a fresh Driver and opening AI Detect from the bottom tab, tapping the X (testID='back-ai') does NOT return the user to the Home tab — the URL stays at /ai-detect and the AI Issue Detection screen remains rendered. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/ai.tsx uses useFocusEffect(() => router.push('/ai-detect')). When close is tapped on ai-detect, router.back() pops back to (tabs)/ai, but the AiTab immediately regains focus, useFocusEffect fires, and it pushes /ai-detect again — creating an inescapable bounce. The hardening added to ai-detect.tsx (canGoBack fallback) does not help because canGoBack() returns true (there IS a history entry: /ai), so router.back() runs and gets bounced right back. Shortcut path (ai-detect-shortcut) close was not testable because the tab-bounce keeps the user stuck on ai-detect. Regression tests for other tabs and re-entry could not be completed for the same reason.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping X (testID='back-ai') on /ai-detect does not navigate to Home tab. URL remains /ai-detect after tap; AI Issue Detection screen is still rendered. Reproduced 100% via bottom-tab entry.

integration_issues.issue: Infinite bounce between /(tabs)/ai and /ai-detect. Close (router.back()) pops to (tabs)/ai; AiTab's useFocusEffect immediately re-pushes /ai-detect. User is trapped on AI Detect.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/ai.tsx: the useFocusEffect(() => router.push('/ai-detect')) creates an infinite bounce with router.back() from ai-detect.tsx. Recommended fix: replace the useFocusEffect approach with a Tabs listener that only fires on user tab-press (not on programmatic focus returns). E.g., in _layout.tsx use <Tabs.Screen name='ai' listeners={{ tabPress: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); router.push('/ai-detect'); } }} /> and remove the ai.tsx focus-push entirely (or make ai.tsx a pure placeholder). This way, tapping the tab pushes /ai-detect, but returning via router.back() does NOT re-trigger the push.

Alternative fix (less clean): in ai.tsx, guard the push with a ref so it only runs once per fresh mount, OR check current segments and only push if not already on ai-detect (still racy on quick back).

After fix, retest: (1) open AI Detect via bottom tab -> tap X -> verify URL becomes /(tabs) and Home greeting appears; (2) same via ai-detect-shortcut on Home; (3) tap X mid-analysis (photo picked, no result); (4) regression: switch between Home/Requests/AI Detect/Profile tabs successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: useFocusEffect for navigation-side-effects is anti-pattern for tab entries — it fires on every focus (including back-navigation focus), causing loops. Prefer a tabPress listener when the goal is 'tapping the tab should open a modal-style screen'.
router.canGoBack() cannot distinguish a 'safe back' from a 'back that will just bounce forward again'. The fallback to router.replace('/(tabs)') never triggers here because canGoBack is true.
Consider presenting ai-detect as a modal (Stack.Screen options={{ presentation: 'modal' }}) with its own dismiss, so it is unambiguously outside the tab stack.
seed_data_creation: Registered one fresh Driver user via UI (email: driver<timestamp>@test.com / driver123, role=user, vehicle=Sedan/KA01AB1234). No cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The current fix in ai-detect.tsx (canGoBack fallback) does NOT solve the bug because the AiTab (ai.tsx) re-pushes /ai-detect via useFocusEffect on every focus. Any solution MUST prevent AiTab from auto-pushing when the user is returning via back navigation. Recommended approach: use Tabs.Screen listeners={{ tabPress }} in (tabs)/_layout.tsx and turn ai.tsx into an inert placeholder. Public preview URL: https://emergency-assist-106.preview.emergentagent.com. Register a Driver via UI, then verify: after tapping AI Detect tab (URL -> /ai-detect), tap X (testID='back-ai'), URL must become /(tabs) with Home 'Hey, <name>' greeting + REQUEST HELP NOW button visible.
rca_of_issue: RCA: Tab entry 'ai' (file /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/ai.tsx) uses useFocusEffect to programmatically navigate to /ai-detect. useFocusEffect fires whenever the AiTab route regains focus, including when the user pops back from /ai-detect. Sequence: (1) user on /(tabs)/index (Home); (2) taps 'AI Detect' tab -> route becomes /(tabs)/ai -> useFocusEffect fires -> router.push('/ai-detect'); (3) user taps X -> ai-detect.tsx runs router.back() (canGoBack=true) -> route pops to /(tabs)/ai -> AiTab regains focus -> useFocusEffect fires again -> router.push('/ai-detect'). Net effect: infinite loop; user stays on ai-detect. Repro confirmed: after tapping X, page.url() remained https://emergency-assist-106.preview.emergentagent.com/ai-detect and 'AI Issue Detection' title still visible. Mitigation: move the redirect logic out of a focus-effect and into a tabPress listener on the Tab screen, so it only fires on explicit user tap and not on programmatic focus returns.
